facts.statement: Pitekunsaurus was described by L. Filippi and A. Garrido in 2008.
facts.quote: It was described by L. Filippi and A. Garrido in 2008.

facts.statement: The species name honors Luis Macaya, an oil company explorer who discovered the fossil in April 2004.
facts.quote: the epitheton honours the discoverer, oil company explorer Luis Macaya, who found the fossil in April 2004.

facts.statement: Pitekunsaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Anacleto Formation of Neuquén, Argentina.
facts.quote: Pitekunsaurus is a genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous Anacleto Formation of Neuquén, Argentina.

facts.statement: Pitekunsaurus is classified as an aeolosaurid, closely related to the genera Gondwanatitan and Aeolosaurus.
facts.quote: Pitekunsaurus appears to be a genus of aeolosaurid, most closely related to the genera Gondwanatitan and Aeolosaurus.

facts.statement: The braincase of Pitekunsaurus closely resembles those of Muyelensaurus, Vahiny, and Jainosaurus.
facts.quote: Its braincase closely resembles that of the aeolosaurid Muyelensaurus as well as the titanosaurs incertae sedis Vahiny and Jainosaurus.

facts.statement: Pitekunsaurus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)
